categories.name: Monthly Income
categories.description: Recurring income from payroll, salary, direct deposit, stipends, reimbursements, and other regular deposits.

categories.name: Utilities
categories.description: Bills for electricity, gas, water, internet, phone service, cable, and other household utilities.

categories.name: Groceries
categories.description: Food and household grocery purchases from larger supermarkets, specialty grocers, and wholesale clubs. In NYC, favor larger named grocery chains over small neighborhood markets.

categories.name: Transportation
categories.description: Ride shares, fuel, public transit, parking, tolls, and other transportation costs.

categories.name: Eating Out
categories.description: Restaurants, cafes, takeout, delivery, delis, bodegas, and other prepared food purchases. In NYC, smaller neighborhood markets often belong here rather than Groceries.

categories.name: Healthcare
categories.description: Medical visits, pharmacies, clinics, prescriptions, and wellness services.

categories.name: Clothes/Personal Care
categories.description: Clothing, grooming, beauty, toiletries, and personal care purchases.

categories.name: Housing Supplies
categories.description: Home improvement, cleaning supplies, hardware, furniture, and household goods.

categories.name: Entertainment
categories.description: Streaming, events, digital subscriptions, movies, games, concerts, and recreation.

categories.name: Unknown
categories.description: Transactions that could not be confidently categorized. Review these manually and update merchant knowledge as needed.
